With a sheet open, the two small planes hide Sphere, Display, Fit and the legend chip. Only the title chips stay, and Y's chip reads w only. src/phone.css.

Numbers opens the Editor with Parameters only, headed Numbers («Числа»). A card or the F tile brings the selection back. dsr p2: the Numbers sheet holds only the number rows and + Number. src/phone.js setNums.

The card of the step being played has the accent outline (.playing). In All at once it is the last card, which now shows the deformation itself (math-1). A held picture hides its t label, so no card shows a wrong t. Probe dsr a4: f2 card 'sel quiet stale playing', the held cards have no t label.

Same as russian-1 (the Russian F tile). Fixed there: «Аналитична» on one line.

The temporary Inspector's head reads 'Inspector' («Инспектор»), with the Esc key cap and ×. Its dialog name is Inspector too. inspector.js.

Not a v15 change. The header markup in work/xva equals v15-base's (only the right toggle's label changed), so the 768 px header is the v14 base's. Check it against frames f5 and f6 after the v14 merge, as the finding says.

In All at once, card k draws the deformation itself up to step k (map mode 3, a = 0, b = k, t), over its grey start (b = k − 1). So the last card equals the main plane at every t. One after another is unchanged. Shot m3-def-allatonce: the f₃ card shows the main picture's shape at t = 0.5. app.js cardDef.

A bound value out of range (r = a ≤ 0, a count outside 1 to 60) or a formula with no value now makes the shape undefined. It is not drawn, its row says why ('r = a = −0.3: a radius must be positive'), its eye is disabled, and it comes back when the value is valid again. Probe m2_params: a = −0.3 gives that row text. app.js applyBinds.

At load (init) and on undo and redo, Params.recompute() and applyBinds on every shape and target run before the first render (bindsAll). Probe m2_params case d5: b = 2a + 1 saved as 7 opens as 2, and the disc bound to b has r = 2.

Guide: 'the point becomes a zero of f_k ∘ … ∘ f₁ exactly, and of F when f_k is the last step'. Menu: when active steps follow f_k, a muted line gives F there, from rangeF(k, n)(0). Probe m1 case B: 'F there: 1.00 (f₂ follows)'.
The 'also at' line now shows for Add pole too. Probe m1 case A: 'Add pole of f₃ here / also at z + 2πik'.

A Möbius step with ad − bc = 0 has no pole mark and no markers from it; its map is the exact constant. The Inspector adds 'f₁ is constant, = 1; z = −1 is removable.' The menu says 'every point maps here: an earlier step is constant'. Shot m2-mob-degenerate: no × at −1, the note under the determinant. Probe m1 case C.

A zero or pole added from the menu is stored at 15 significant digits, and a part below 1e-15 of the other is set to 0. Probe m1: fields read 0.58+0.96i, 0.85+1.32i and 0.8; F_k at the point stays below 1e-15. A value typed or loaded with noise is kept as the user's text.
The menu head treats a part below 1e-12 of the other as 0 and prints at most 6 decimals. Probe m1: 'F(z) = −2.20' (Joukowski) and 'F(z) = −2.00' (constant F).
Y's fit frames an image that is a point up to rounding (span below 1e-9·max(1, |w|)) as ±1 around it. The old floor never fired. Shot m2-mob-degenerate: Y at 0.5 / div around 1. app.js robustBox.

figureState now carries the Landscape camera (relative to its fit) and the deformation (open, T). A link or scene applies them once at load; they are never kept in the saved state. Probe m4_link: yaw 0.7 and pitch 0.9 come back, deformation open at T = 1.25, F identical.

A step's formula keeps its shared numbers as names: (w₁ − 1)/(a w₁ + 1) and (2a + 1)(w₂ − a)(w₂ + 0.5i)(w₂ + a)/(w₂ + 0.8 − 0.75i). The step is built again with sentinel numbers, which are then replaced by each field's TeX; it falls back to the values if a sentinel does not come through. The previous fixer's version printed '[object Object]' (Expr.toTex returns {s, p}); fixed and checked in the browser. inspector.js namedTex.

symOf has sin (π − z + 2πk, z + 2πk) and cos (−z + 2πk, z + 2πk). An earlier constant step gives 'every point maps here'. Polynomial and rational steps say 'also at n other points, counted with multiplicity'. Probe m1 cases H and I.
